title: Marie Rose Sauce with Prawns
preamble:
Ingredients:-
2
tablespoons of good-quality mayonnaise
1
tablespoon ketchup
a
pinch of cayenne pepper
sea
salt and freshly ground black pepper
1
lemon
4
handfuls of cooked, peeled prawns
cress
or fresh flat-parsley leaves, to serve

luttuce.

Method:-
Squeeze half a lemon into the rest of the ingredients and mix.
Add the prawns.
Serve with slices of the lemon and parsley on a bed of shredded lettuce.
